title: SJU Community Garden Harvesting
location: Between Merion Hall and Fine Arts East, Merion Station, PA
description: Assist with weeding and harvesting vegetables from the garden in support of food security initiatives.

title: Barnes Arboretum Horticulture & Plant Stewardship
location: 300 N Latch's Ln, Merion Station, PA (SJU Arboretum)
description: Support university horticulture staff in weeding, trail mulching, caring for heritage woody plants, and managing invasive species across SJU's 12-acre arboretum.

title: Love Your Park Fall Service Weekend
organization: Fairmount Park Conservancy & Philly Parks & Rec
location: West Fairmount Park & Centennial District Sites
description: Join thousands of volunteers across Philly for the annual fall clean-and-green effort planting street trees, cleaning waterways, collecting leaves, and preparing parks for winter.

title: Second Saturday Natural Lands Restoration
date: 2nd Saturday of Every Month • 10:00 AM - 1:00 PM
description: Hands-on forest restoration projects tackling invasive porcelain berry and English ivy, planting native saplings, and stabilizing trail edges near the Schuylkill River.

title: Cobbs Creek Watershed Ambassador Cleanup
location: 63rd & Market St / Florence Ave & Cobbs Creek Pkwy
description: Help West Philadelphia neighbors clean up trash and floatables along stream banks and trails to protect Cobbs Creek and downstream Delaware River water quality.

title: StreamKeepers Watershed Water Quality Monitoring
location: Rolling Hill Park & Mill Creek (1301 Rose Glen Rd)
description: Track stream bank erosion, riparian plant buffers, stormwater runoff, and aquatic health along Mill Creek and Indian Creek as part of the Delaware River Watershed Initiative.

title: Sankofa Farm & Tidal Wetland Stewardship
description: Volunteer with farm and horticulture staff on seasonal outdoor tasks: weeding, harvesting, composting, and clearing litter along the tidal Schuylkill riverfront.
